# ADR-3245: AWS s3: Prefer Object Lock for compliance bucket 5

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Soft deletes are insufficient for some regimes.

## Decision

Compliance stores SHOULD prefer Object Lock for compliance bucket 5 (AWS-s3-5) when retention is legally required.

## Consequences

Retention modes are legal-reviewed.
